reason: Full independent review of the SHA-256-matched pinned raw, accepted receipt, candidate, Platforms concept route, and both actual Q1/Q2 answers found one misleading response guarantee. The 200 schema marks the account-level schedule id optional at raw line 72, but the candidate says the response returns account-level schedule identity without that qualification. A reader using this source to decide whether every successful application supplies a schedule ID could rely on an ID the contract does not require. The five quotes and their locations, other retained claims, query answers, and reciprocal route check out.
required_changes: Qualify the account-level schedule id in the source Key takeaways as optional in the 200 schema (raw line 72). Keep the required response fields distinct: balanceAccountId, balancePlatformPayoutScheduleId, createdAt and transferInstrumentId (raw lines 64–66 and 79). Reword the first bullet's 'returned account-level schedule id' if needed so it does not imply that every 200 includes it.
